title: frasera albicaulis var. nitida
intro: Frasera albicaulis var. nitida, commonly known as the white fringe cup, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the gentian family (Gentianaceae). It is native to North America, specifically in the mountainous regions of western Canada and the United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Frasera albicaulis var. nitida include iridoid glycosides, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects.
